attack_s.rationale: Synthetic smoothing time for increasing load and transient intensity.

crossfade_s.rationale: Synthetic edge blend for the bounded looping physical texture.

decay_s.rationale: Synthetic smoothing time for decreasing load and transient intensity.

fixed_output_gain.rationale: One conservative fixed gain shared by every offline schedule.

max_adjacent_step.rationale: Automated discontinuity proxy threshold for normalized output samples.

max_dc.rationale: Automated DC proxy threshold for normalized output samples.

stereo_width.rationale: Synthetic bounded side-component width without spatial calibration.

texture_mix.rationale: Synthetic fixed pressure-to-audition mix for the accepted PTR texture.

transient_gain.rationale: Synthetic bounded emphasis driven continuously by RPM and load derivatives.
